dedup_engine.layer_1_fingerprint: lowercase → strip punctuation → drop stop-words ("a, the, of, new, update, today, latest...")
dedup_engine.layer_2_similarity: similar(A,B) = Jaccard(tokens) ≥ 0.55 OR shingle3(char-3grams) ≥ 0.55 OR (Jaccard ≥ 0.45 AND shingle3 ≥ 0.30)

personal_seen_json.purpose: Jobs retry after 12h — if Telegram post failed, item NOT marked → auto-retry next 30min run

global_seen_json.purpose: Cross-pipeline — CA story can't reappear in Jobs (and vice versa)

dedup_engine.layer_4_in_batch_dedup: Within single post, similarity ≥ threshold → collapse to one item
dedup_engine.store_format: Pure JSON — no database (1GB RAM friendly)
dedup_engine.store_write: Atomic (write temp → rename) — safe on crash
dedup_engine.store_migration: Legacy formats auto-migrate; stores safe to delete (worst case = one story repeats once)
